gloss_en: Oil (shemen), the noun for anointing/lamp oil — the substance used for anointing (David's malchut, 'oil of gladness'), fueling the seven lamps of the Menorah, and figuratively the bodily moisture/lachluchit that fuels the brain-wick and heals the lungs; NOT manna, NOT 'fat/fatness' (shaman/shuman) as a verb or adjective, and NOT 'eighth' (shemini)
